description: Preference-based eval cases for subjective 12 Week Year coach outputs. These are not exact-match answers.

input_context.task: Generate weekly review coaching for a user whose language study is on track but running is behind.
input_context.weekly_summary: Week 3: French listening 44/40 and writing 5/5 complete. Running 1/3 sessions and 8/24km complete. User wrote: 'Running plan did not happen; rain was an excuse.'

cases.preferred_output: 法語這週不是問題，真正的風險是跑步被天氣和行程吃掉。下週不要把跑步寫成『有空就跑』，請直接排三個 30 分鐘固定時段；如果下雨，改成跑步機或室內 Zone 2，不能讓天氣決定。優先順序：先保住法語節奏，再把跑步恢復到 2 次，第三次當 bonus。
cases.rejected_output: 你這週做得很好，繼續保持。下週要更努力安排時間，保持正向心態，相信自己可以完成所有目標。
preference_reason: preferred output names the actual lagging goal
preferred output uses the user's rain excuse note
preferred output gives concrete next-week actions

input_context.task: Choose today's priorities when the user is behind on interview prep and low on recovery.
input_context.daily_state: Week 8, 28 days left. LeetCode is 22 problems behind. Running is 15 sessions behind. Sleep 5h, HRV 40, mood 1 yesterday.

cases.preferred_output: 今天不要同時追 LC 和跑步量。主線只放兩件事：1) LC 2 題，其中 1 題必須完整寫下解法復盤；2) 20 分鐘低強度走路或伸展，目的不是補跑量，是恢復 HRV。今晚 22:30 前睡，否則明天的追趕會繼續掉線。
cases.rejected_output: 今天可以安排 LeetCode、跑步、休息和學習，每一項都做一點，讓自己回到正軌。
preference_reason: preferred output makes a tradeoff instead of listing everything
preferred output references 22 problems behind, low HRV, and sleep
preferred output explains why recovery is part of execution

input_context.task: Turn a vague user goal into a measurable 12-week target.
input_context.goal: I want to become better at writing technical essays so I can publish more consistently.

cases.preferred_output: 12 週終點：完成並發布 6 篇 900-1400 字技術文章，其中至少 3 篇來自真實專案決策或踩坑復盤。每週固定產出：1 個 outline、1 個 draft、1 次 revision。衡量方式不是『有沒有變好』，而是發布篇數、每篇是否有具體例子、以及是否能清楚說出一個工程取捨。
cases.rejected_output: 你的目標是提升技術寫作能力。接下來 12 週請多閱讀、多練習、多反思，逐步建立自己的寫作風格。
preference_reason: preferred output turns vague writing improvement into measurable delivery
preferred output avoids abstract self-improvement language
